name: Daughter of Pharaoh
summary: The daughter of Pharaoh who found baby Moses in a little ark by the river. She raised him as her own son and gave him his name.

key_moments.title: Finds a Baby Among the Reeds
key_moments.description: She came down to bathe at the river and saw the little ark among the reeds. When she opened it and the baby cried, she felt pity for him and knew he was a Hebrew child.

key_moments.title: Hires a Nurse for the Child
key_moments.description: The baby's sister offered to find a Hebrew woman to nurse him. Pharaoh's daughter agreed and paid the child's own mother to nurse him.

key_moments.title: She Names Him Moses
key_moments.description: When the child grew, he became her son. She named him Moses, because she had pulled him from the water.
